info.title: dev-site API
info.description: API specification for the dev-site service

get.description: Paginated list of analyzed commits with rollup summary metrics for timeline display. Does not include per-package / export / test-case inventories — fetch those via GET /commits/{hash}.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor (commit hash of the last item from the previous page). Omit for the first page.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` on the next request. Null when there are no more pages.

get.summary: Get the full analysis snapshot for a commit
get.description: Returns commit metadata plus per-package metrics, exports, and test cases for a single analyzed commit.

404.description: No analysis snapshot found for this commit hash.

get.description: Compare the analysis snapshots of two commits. `hash` is the baseline ("before"); `otherHash` is the comparison ("after"). Returns added/removed (and changed, for package metrics) inventories.

200.description: Delta between the two commit snapshots.

404.description: One or both commit hashes have no analysis snapshot.

get.summary: Package-scoped symbols for one analyzed commit
get.description: Returns metrics, exports, and test cases for a single package at a commit. Prefer this over full commit detail for the checkout Spec panel — assembly only touches that package's source blobs. For db packages, also includes `dbInventory` (drizzle tables + query dirs). For `-spec` packages, also includes `specInventory` (OpenAPI schemas + REST resources). For `-http` packages, `specInventory` is the sibling `-spec` triangle join (route cards) while exports/tests remain the HTTP or SDK package's own source modules. For Vue SPA / `-vue` packages, `specInventory` is the product `-spec` joined through SDK request imports so Spec can show loader routes on a component bundle. `layoutIssues` are live working-tree layout/LoC findings for the package directory (cheap; package-local). Full dead-code workdir scans stay on `saf-dev-site issues --workdir` — not on this Spec package load.

layoutIssues.description: Working-tree package-layout and oversized-file findings (package-local; cheap). Dead-code workdir scans are CLI-only.

publicExportFilePaths.description: Repo-relative files from live package.json `exports` (SPA main.ts, test-app.ts). Spec Issues skips these for dead-code so the panel matches `saf-dev-site issues --workdir`.

post.description: Walk git history since the last recorded commit (plus feature-branch tips) and store static-analysis snapshots. Manual trigger — no automatic poller in v1. Request body is an empty object so clients can POST JSON without special-casing.

schema.description: Scan options. Empty object is fine for a full scan; `limit` caps how many new mainline commits are analyzed in this run (feature-branch tips are skipped when limit is set).

limit.description: Max new mainline commits to analyze this run (default 1). Feature-branch tips are skipped when limit is set. Ignored when `commitHash` is set.

commitHash.description: Analyze exactly this commit (if not already stored). Used by Current checkout "Scan this commit".

200.description: Scan completed with no per-commit failures; returns which commits were ingested.

scanned.description: Commit hashes newly analyzed and stored.

failed.description: Always empty on 200; non-empty failures use 500.

500.description: Git plumbing failed, or one or more commits failed analysis (`SCAN_FAILED`).

get.description: Resolve git HEAD and report whether that commit has been analyzed, plus package metrics when it has. Also reports local branch compare candidates and the fork-point (merge-base) of HEAD vs `compareRef` (default `main`). Used by the Current checkout UI.

parameters.name: compareRef
parameters.description: Local branch name to take the merge-base against. Defaults to the server `main` ref.

productRoot.description: Analysis path prefix within the repo (e.g. `products`). Empty string means the whole repository. Package `directory` values are relative to this prefix; prepend it for repo-absolute paths.

branch.description: Short branch name for HEAD, or null when detached.

compareCandidates.description: Local branch names that can be used as `compareRef` (current branch omitted; configured main ref always included when it exists).

400.description: compareRef is not a valid git object.

get.description: List blob paths at a commit (git ls-tree), optionally filtered by path prefix and/or file extension(s). Prefix matches the exact path, descendants (`docs` matches `docs/guide.md`), and files sharing the stem (`src/Foo` matches `src/Foo.ts`, `src/Foo.vue`, `src/Foo.test.ts` — not `src/FooAsync.vue`). Used for browsing docs and source without checking out.

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description: Commit hash (or other tree-ish) to list.

parameters.name: prefix
parameters.description: Optional path prefix (repo-relative). Matches exact path, descendants (`docs` matches `docs` and `docs/guide.md`), and stem siblings (`src/Foo` matches `src/Foo.ts` and `src/Foo.test.ts`).

parameters.name: ext
parameters.description: Optional file extension filter (e.g. `.md`). May be repeated (`ext=.md&ext=.txt`) or comma-separated (`ext=.md,.txt`).

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: When true, include UTF-8 `content` for each matching file. Requires `prefix` so the whole tree is not dumped.

path.description: Path relative to the repo root.

blobHash.description: Git blob object hash. Empty string for working-tree-only files at HEAD that are not in the commit tree.

get.summary: Read a file at a commit
get.description: Read the UTF-8 contents of one blob at a commit by repo-relative path. Returns 404 when the path is missing at that ref.

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description: Commit hash (or other tree-ish) to read from.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path relative to the repo root.

commit-ref.description: A branch or tag pointer observed at scan time for a commit.

name.description: Ref name without the `refs/heads/` or `refs/tags/` prefix.

type.description: Whether this ref is a branch or a tag.

isMainAncestor.description: True when this commit is an ancestor of the configured main branch (including main itself). Used to distinguish mainline history from feature-branch tips.

issue-counts-by-kind.description: Per-kind issue counts for a commit or package (all kinds count as debt).

commit-summary.description: List-friendly commit row — same metadata as Commit, without the nested inventory payloads. Used by GET /commits.

summaryMetrics.description: Rollup counts across all packages at this commit, for timeline health indicators without fetching CommitDetail.

debtCount.description: Sum of all issue kinds (dead-code + oversized-file + package-layout).

hasIssueStats.description: True when package_issue_stats were computed for this commit (including a zero-debt sentinel). False for commits scanned before issue stats.

commit.description: Analyzed commit metadata — one row per scanned commit. Does not include per-package / export / test-case payloads (see CommitDetail for those).

parentHashes.description: Parent commit hashes (empty for the root commit).

refs.description: Branch/tag pointers that currently resolve to this commit.

analyzerVersion.description: Version string of the analyzer that produced this snapshot.

computedAt.description: When this snapshot was written to the database.

package-metrics.description: Per-package file/LOC inventory at a single commit.

directory.description: Package directory relative to the analyzed product root.

debtCount.description: Sum of all issue kinds (dead-code + oversized-file + package-layout).

export-entry.description: One exported symbol extracted from a source file at a commit.

packageName.description: npm package that owns this file.

filePath.description: Path relative to the repo root.

signature.description: Syntactic display signature from the AST (no type-checker). Null for re-exports without a local declaration.

docstring.description: First prose line of the leading JSDoc on the export declaration. Null when absent or for bare re-exports (`export { a }`).
docstring.example: Walk commits newest-first without checking out.

usedBy.description: Non-test product files that import this export (named import match, or whole-module import when names are `*` / default / empty).

filePath.description: Path within the importing package (no package-root prefix).

test-case.description: One `describe`/`it`/`test` case extracted from a test file. `fullName` uses the `" > "` separator from `@saflib/parser` (e.g. `"outer > inner > does the thing"`). Optional `subject*` fields soft-link to an exported symbol by convention (suite title matching an adjacent or same-package export).

packageName.description: npm package that owns this file.

filePath.description: Path relative to the repo root.

fullName.example: log > returns commits newest-first (git log order)

subjectName.description: Linked export name when a suite title matches by convention.

subjectSignature.description: Signature of the linked export at this commit (null if unknown).

subjectDocstring.description: First JSDoc prose line of the linked export, when present.

subjectFilePath.description: Repo-relative path of the file that declares the linked export.

subjectConfidence.description: How the link was made (`adjacent` file vs elsewhere in package).

commit-detail.description: Full static-analysis snapshot for one commit — metadata plus per-package metrics, exports, and test cases.

code.description: A short, machine-readable error code, for when HTTP status codes are not sufficient.

message.description: A human-readable description of the error.
message.example: The requested resource could not be found.

db-schema-table.description: A drizzle table identity for schema diffs.

db-schema-column.description: A drizzle column identity for schema diffs.

commit-diff.description: Delta between two analyzed commits. Exports and test cases are identity-based (add/remove only — a rename shows up as remove + add). Package metrics include a `changed` list when the same packageName exists on both sides with different counts.

dbSchemas.description: Structural drizzle table/column deltas across both commits.

db-inventory.description: Drizzle table inventory for one db package (schemas + query dirs).

entity.description: Query directory name or kebab form of table name (e.g. package-metrics).

docstring.description: First prose line of leading JSDoc on the table const.
First prose line of leading JSDoc on the column.

usedByPackages.description: Distinct packages (non-test) that import any query under this entity.

queries.description: Leaf query modules under queries/<entity>/ (excluding index and tests).

usedBy.description: Non-test product files that import this leaf query module.

filePath.description: Path within the importing package (no package-root prefix).
Path within the importing package (no package-root prefix).

spec-inventory.description: OpenAPI inventory for one `-spec` package — business objects (schemas/) and/or REST resources (routes/), linked by normalized name stems. Operations include triangle links to sibling `-http` handlers and `-sdk` requests when present. Also attached to `-http` package detail (sibling join) for the HTTP Spec pane.

packageDirectory.description: Repo-relative directory of the `-spec` package this inventory was built from (used for route YAML source links when shown from an `-http` pane).

entities.description: Flat alphabetical list of object / both / routes entities.

key.description: Stable entity key (e.g. both:Matter, routes:admin, object:Error).

label.description: Display name — schema component name when present, else resource folder.

presence.description: object = schema only; routes = REST resource only; both = schema + matching resource.

yamlPath.description: Package-relative path to the schema YAML.

referencedByOperations.description: operationIds whose request/2xx response $ref this schema.

usedByPackages.description: Distinct packages importing this entity's schema and/or the SDK request modules for its operations.

operations.description: REST operations under the linked resource (empty for object-only).

yamlPath.description: Package-relative route YAML under the spec package.

handler.description: Sibling HTTP handler file when present.

request.description: Sibling SDK request module when present.

fake.description: Sibling SDK fake/MSW module (`*.fake.ts`) when present beside the request.

handlerTests.description: describe/it/test specifications extracted from colocated HTTP handler test files (fullName uses " > " nesting).

fullName.example: createMatter > creates a matter for the org

requestSchemas.description: Business objects in the request body (one layer deep into object/array bags of schema refs).

responseSchemas.description: Business objects in 2xx responses (one layer deep into object/array bags of schema refs).

usedBy.description: Non-test product files importing the sibling SDK request module for this route stem.

filePath.description: Path within the importing package (no package-root prefix).

enqueues.description: operationIds this op may enqueue (product job trigger map). Present only when the HTTP app was configured with a map.

enqueuedBy.description: operationIds or `cron:…` keys that may enqueue this op. Present only when the HTTP app was configured with a map.

checkout-compare.description: Fork-point (merge-base of HEAD and a chosen branch) for Checkout compare mode.

mergeBaseAnalyzed.description: True when that fork-point commit has an analysis snapshot.

mergeBaseAuthoredAt.description: Author date of the fork-point commit.

client.description: The frontend client that triggered the event. For web, it should be "web-{spa-name}".

view.description: The page that triggered the event. For vue, it should be the route name provided by vue router.

component.description: The component that triggered the event. For vue, it should be the component name.
